fixer.summary: Fixed. The out-of-turn refusal for spending a Bonus Action now cites p.10, `PLAY.actions.bonus-actions`, because a Bonus Action is taken on your own turn. The fix is in `Combat._require_turn` (`dungdra/combat.py`), which now gets the kind of spend from `Combat.spend`. Other out-of-turn spends, and the attack-path refusal in `combat.py`, now cite p.13, `PLAY.combat.the-order-of-combat`; before, neither cited anything. I tagged these with SRD markers that have no clause number, because neither unit has a stage-A `A.json` file. I added 3 unit tests that check the page and rule cited and that nothing gets spent. Results: unit tests 502 passed, the ticket's test passes with `--runxfail`, ruff is clean and dev-gate passes.

review.summary: The out-of-turn refusal in Combat._require_turn now gives a page and rule. A Bonus Action cites PLAY.actions.bonus-actions on p.10. Any other action cites PLAY.combat.the-order-of-combat on p.13. These are the same citations that spend() already uses for the bonus-action and free-interaction refusals next to it. The separate check in _spend_attack now gives the same citation, so attacks out of turn are covered too. The T-73 xfail was removed from the acceptance test because the test now passes; no assertion was dropped. The new unit tests check the citation on the Refusal and that nothing was spent (bonus_used and actions_used are unchanged), so they test behaviour. There is no hard-coding, no second mechanism and no out-of-scope change.
